items.title: paynepride dot com outage on vacation
items.content_html: The day after I leave for vacation I start getting SSL errors on every homelab service I host for myself and others. The culprit was my Cloudflare API token expiring. It was easy to find the 403s in the logs for Traefik (thank goodness for Tailscale getting me into the lab from afar). The solution was to rotate the API token, replace the value in Traefik’s .env file, and hit it with the “just deploy” button. Now I don’t know why this expired - the key looks like it has no expiration to me - and I’m too tired from the beach to dig in further. Until next time, I expect this error to come back March 16 2027 I suppose.
